get_2d_sincos_pos_embed: generate 2D sine-cosine position embeddings for a given grid size and embedding dimension
get_2d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid: compute 2D sine-cosine position embeddings from a pre-built grid tensor
get_1d_sincos_pos_embed_from_grid: compute 1D sine-cosine position embeddings from a list of position values
interpolate_pos_embed: bicubic interpolate checkpoint position embeddings to match a model with a different patch size
review_pos_embed_utils: review the position embedding utility functions for 2D sincos generation and interpolation
